texts.quest.name: Forest Cheese / Config v1
texts.task.meet: Meet the witch at the ruins
texts.task.deliver: Give the cheese to the witch
texts.task.outpost: Meet the witch at the outpost
texts.town: [Config v1] I need help collecting three pieces of ruined cheese. Meet me at the forest ruins.
texts.meet: [Config v1] Thank you for coming! Collect three pieces of cheese here, then bring them back to me.
texts.missing: [Config v1] Still searching? Bring me all three pieces of ruined cheese.
texts.deliver: [Config v1] You found the cheese! I will take three pieces. Meet me at the outpost for your reward.
texts.outpost: [Config v1] Well done. Your reward is 2 High Potions, 1 Revive Potion and 1 Magic Crystal.
texts.insufficient: [Config v1] You collected enough before, but you no longer have three pieces in your bag.
